summary: Iteration 109: Premiação/Votação System Testing - All 16 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified for public view, authenticated athlete voting, admin dashboard, desktop nav, and mobile nav. Complete voting flow working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend (premiacao_routes.py): All 10+ endpoints properly implemented with auth guards
Backend: GET /api/premiacao/status returns public voting status correctly
Backend: GET /api/premiacao/categorias returns categories without vote counts (public)
Backend: POST /api/premiacao/votar validates category, nominee name, and voting status
Backend: GET /api/premiacao/meus-votos returns athlete's votes with proper auth
Backend: Admin endpoints properly protected with get_admin_user dependency
Backend: GET /api/premiacao/resultados-publicos correctly returns 403 when voting is open
Frontend (VotacaoPage.jsx): Proper state handling for open/closed/results views
Frontend (VotacaoPage.jsx): 'Faça login para votar' message for unauthenticated users
Frontend (DashboardPremiacao.jsx): Admin dashboard with categories, status, and results modal
Frontend (RankingPage.js): 'Votação' button added to desktop nav bar with data-testid
Frontend (MobileNav.jsx): 'Votação' link added to mobile drawer with medal icon
Frontend (AdminDashboard.jsx): 'Premiação' menu item in sidebar under 'Gestão' section
seed_data_creation: Test category 'Treinador(a) Destaque' exists with votes. Voting is currently OPEN.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 109 validated the complete Premiação/Votação system: (1) Public endpoints /api/premiacao/status and /api/premiacao/categorias work without auth, (2) Athlete voting via POST /api/premiacao/votar works with proper validation, (3) GET /api/premiacao/meus-votos returns athlete's votes, (4) Admin endpoints protected and functional: /admin/config, /admin/categorias, /admin/abrir, /admin/fechar, /admin/resultados, (5) GET /api/premiacao/resultados-publicos returns 403 when voting is open, (6) Frontend VotacaoPage shows 'Faça login para votar' for unauthenticated users, (7) Authenticated athletes see vote form with progress bar, (8) Admin DashboardPremiacao shows categories with vote counts, status badge, and results modal, (9) Desktop nav has 'Votação' button (data-testid='btn-votacao'), (10) Mobile nav drawer has 'Votação' link (data-testid='mobile-nav-votação'). All features working as expected.

GET /api/premiacao/categorias.details: Returns list of categories without vote counts

POST /api/premiacao/votar.details: Submits vote, validates category and nominee, returns success message

GET /api/premiacao/admin/config.details: Returns config with votacao_aberta, requires admin auth

POST /api/premiacao/admin/categorias.details: Creates category, returns new category with id

GET /api/premiacao/admin/resultados.details: Returns detailed results with vote counts and voters

Frontend /votacao page (authenticated).details: Shows vote form with progress bar

Admin sidebar 'Premiação' menu.details: Menu item visible, navigates to DashboardPremiacao

Admin DashboardPremiacao.details: Shows categories, status badge, toggle button, results modal

Desktop nav 'Votação' button.details: Button visible with data-testid='btn-votacao', navigates to /votacao

Mobile nav 'Votação' link.details: Link visible with medal icon, navigates to /votacao
